# package profinet

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-otfp/protocols/profinet"
```

Package profinet fingerprints PROFINET IO over its DCE/RPC endpoint (connectionless RPC version 4, UDP 34964).

PROFINET IO is an Industrial Ethernet protocol: cyclic data runs over raw Ethernet, and acyclic reads, writes and connection management run over connectionless DCE/RPC on UDP 34964. Detection sends a ReadImplicit (opnum 5) for the I&M0 identification record to the PNIO device interface. A DCE/RPC v4 reply that echoes the request's activity UUID — a response, a fault, a reject or a nocall — identifies PROFINET, since the activity UUID cannot be guessed by an unrelated service.

ReadImplicit needs no connection and no application relationship, so the same probe serves detect and identify: when the device returns the I&M0 record, its vendor ID, order ID (article number), serial number and hardware and software revisions are decoded.

DCP device discovery (Identify-All) runs over raw Layer 2 Ethernet and needs elevated privileges and a local interface; it is out of scope for an IP-endpoint fingerprinter.
